annotations.title: Audit a site for AI search

description: Run a GEO and AEO audit of a website in one call: AI crawler access, llms.txt, schema markup, how the content reads to an engine, and broken links, each with a pass or a fix. Use it when someone asks 'is my site ready for AI search', 'audit my site for ChatGPT and Perplexity', or wants a checklist before publishing. Takes up to a minute. Reads public pages only; changes nothing.

domain.description: The website to check, like acme.com. A full URL is accepted and reduced to its domain.
